description: SMBus Host Notify traffic to the SMBus Host Address. Source: SMBus Specification v3.3 (12 May 2024, SMIF) §6.5.9, §6.6.3.8. One rule per command byte 0x00-0xFF (sender = cmd>>1, X = bit 0, both X values decoded); senders outside 0x09-0x77 or at 0x0C/0x61 are labelled reserved. Status word is little-endian and device specific; e.g. Smart Battery AlarmWarning (sender 0x0B, cmd 0x16) needs the SBS Data spec for bit meanings — out of scope. All rules are writes, so there is no Registers-tab layout. Generated by build_smbus_decoders.py.
byte_order_note: Host Notify status word: Data Byte Low first (Fig 41).
